asked.item: Did I misunderstand what All LinkedIn does?
Why only the profile got the post
How to get same content on profile and company Page

verdict.reason: The pages state that All LinkedIn only makes a slot available to any LinkedIn destination and that the post's own destination controls where it publishes.

steps.text: Yes, All LinkedIn does not publish one post to every LinkedIn destination.
All LinkedIn only allows posts targeting any connected LinkedIn personal profile or company Page to use the slot, and the destination selected on the post still controls where it publishes.
To publish the same content to a personal profile and a company Page, create one post for each destination.
